abstract.value: We investigate the sample complexity of Gaussian mixture models (GMMs).  Our results provide the optimal upper bound, in the context of uniform spherical Gaussian mixtures.  Furthermore, we highlight the relationship between the sample complexity of GMMs and the distribution of spacings among their means.
